labs.name: Utah Public Health Laboratory (UPHL), Environmental Chemistry (listed by DDW as "Utah Department of Health Division of Lab Services (EPA cert.)")
labs.address: 4431 S 2700 W, Taylorsville, UT 84129 (address from UPHL's Client Services Manual; DDW prints "Taylorville, UT, 84119-8600")
labs.detail: Listed by DDW as "Utah Department of Health Division of Lab Services (EPA cert.)". DDW sheet: commercial samples? yes; CMDP (EPA data portal) status: LIVE; drinking-water PFAS: certified; codes as printed: TNI - 02771, UT - 00002, state ID E - 10429. DDW ticks 62 analyte columns for this lab.
labs.source_name: Utah DEQ Division of Drinking Water: Utah's Certified Laboratories - Drinking Water (online sheet, no revision date printed)
labs.note: The state lab. Its Private Wells page says well owners should test at least every year for nitrate, pH, total dissolved solids and total coliform/E. coli. Its posted fee schedule (no date printed): total coliform/E. coli $20.90; nitrate $17.60 (nitrate + nitrite $20.00); pH $12.00; total dissolved solids $14.03; arsenic, lead and most other metals $13.20 each (plus a $24.20 digestion fee per sample if turbidity is above 1); fluoride $25.00; PFAS (EPA 533) $505.00. Those four annual tests add up to $64.53 at the posted prices. Uranium is not on its fee schedule. Its water-bacteria form has a box for compliance samples that says "Do Not Check Box if Private Investigative", and it rejects samples that are "Not State Lab Container", so get bottles and forms from the lab first: sample receiving (801) 965-2405, Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm (Client Services Manual, May 2025). Bacteria testing must begin within 30 hours of collection.
labs.source_name_2: UPHL Service Fee Schedule, Private Wells page and Water Bacteriological form (fetched 2026-11-19)

labs.name: Bear River District Health Department Water Laboratory
labs.address: Drop-off: Environmental Building, 85 East 1800 North, Logan, UT (DDW lists the lab at 655 E 1300 N, Logan, UT 84341)
labs.detail: DDW sheet: commercial samples? no; CMDP (EPA data portal) status: LIVE; drinking-water PFAS: not certified; codes as printed: TNI - 01961, UT - 00936, state ID 8017535135. DDW ticks 4 analyte columns for this lab.
labs.source_name: Utah DEQ Division of Drinking Water: Utah's Certified Laboratories - Drinking Water (online sheet, no revision date printed)
labs.note: Bear River Health Department's page says it tests water for coliform/E. coli and nitrate: $25 presence/absence bacteria, $30 quantitative bacteria, $30 nitrate. Pick up a sterile bottle at the Environmental Health office; samples are received Monday-Thursday 8 am-6 pm and Friday 8 am-1 pm (holiday weeks differ). On October 19, 2026 its Board of Health approved a 2026 fee schedule that raises quantitative bacteria and nitrate from $30 to $35; the documents we found do not give an effective date, so confirm the price when you pick up a bottle.
labs.source_name_2: Bear River Health Department: Environmental services page (fetched 2026-11-19); 2026 fee schedule and Oct 19, 2026 board minutes on utah.gov/pmn

labs.name: Davis County Environmental Health Laboratory
labs.detail: DDW sheet: commercial samples? no; CMDP (EPA data portal) status: LIVE; drinking-water PFAS: not certified; codes as printed: TNI - 01975, UT - 00934, state ID 8014513292. DDW ticks 4 analyte columns for this lab.
labs.source_name: Utah DEQ Division of Drinking Water: Utah's Certified Laboratories - Drinking Water (online sheet, no revision date printed)
labs.note: Davis County's lab page lists a "Well (private) Sample Fee" of $12 for coliform/E. coli, paid before the sample is collected and tested. Fill out its Water Sample for Bacteriologic Examination form, keep the sample between 34°F and 50°F, and bring it in before 3:00 pm Monday-Thursday (not the day before a legal holiday). Samples older than 30 hours are rejected. The page says you may bring a sample "from anywhere, including from out-of-state". It tests bacteria only; for nitrate or arsenic use another lab. Health department main line: (801) 525-5000.
labs.source_name_2: Davis County Health Department: Environmental Health Laboratory page (fetched 2026-11-19)

labs.address: 620 S 400 E, Suite 400, St. George, UT 84770
labs.detail: DDW sheet: commercial samples? no; CMDP (EPA data portal) status: Yet to Initiate; drinking-water PFAS: not certified; codes as printed: TNI - 02252, UT - 00955, state ID 4359862580. DDW ticks 4 analyte columns for this lab.

labs.note: Its Water Lab page says it tests private drinking water "upon request" for coliform and E. coli (presence/absence) and nitrate. Fees: $30 per drinking-water bacteria sample, $30 per nitrate sample. Use its sterile bottles (free). Receiving: St. George Monday-Thursday 8 am-4 pm; Cedar City Tuesday 8 am-noon; Panguitch 1st Tuesday; Kanab 2nd and 4th Tuesday; Beaver 2nd Tuesday (not in November). No samples on Fridays, weekends, holidays or the business day before a holiday; nitrate only Wednesday and Thursday. Bacteria samples must arrive within 24 hours, kept below 50°F. The lab page gives (435) 986-2580; DDW lists (435) 986-2598.
labs.source_name_2: Southwest Utah Public Health Department: Water Lab page and Fee Schedule (fetched 2026-11-19)
